prompt: llm-shape skill: shape the prescribed 山手線 stretch of as-jpn-tokyo-jr-shape-rect (variant orig-llm-skeleton2grid-opus5) into its prescribed shape (square).

transcript.note: Round 1, one batch. Target square x in [15,37], y in [14,36] (side 22) chosen because the ring already sits on two of those lines: its six west stations (35,86,22,39,95,53) are all on col 15 and its four south stations (61,30,38,8) are all on row 36, so those sides need no movement at all. Sides were assigned by RING-ORDER ARC, not by radial angle: R=[11,24,46,47,88,83,57,55,87,64] (col 37, rows 14..31 kept in their current increasing order), B=[61,30,38,8] (row 36, unchanged), L=[35,86,22,39,95,53] (col 15, unchanged except 53 slid 13->14 so it lands exactly on the TL corner), T=[17,19,71] (row 14, x 18/20/21). 11 lands exactly on the TR corner, so only two corner control points are needed: (37,36) between 64 and 61 and (15,36) between 8 and 35. Every non-ring point was carried along by one continuous deformation so nothing was left behind to block the batch: interior points via mean-value coordinates over the old ring mapped onto the square (bijective because the square is convex, so no interior winding order can flip), exterior points by translating with the local boundary displacement and fading that translation linearly to zero at the canvas edge along the outward ray (a monotone map along each ray, so the squeezed east strip between the old col-31 boundary and the new col-37 side compresses evenly instead of collapsing). A first attempt with a purely radial (angle-preserving) warp put 24/46 on the top side and broke the winding order at hubs 65/96/24/5; the arc assignment fixed all of it. Only one point then still failed: 68 landed at (39,25) exactly on the line 55(37,27)-79(41,23), which both put a point on a segment and made 68 and 79 share an angle at 55; moving 68 one cell east to (40,25) cleared the point-on-segment and both hub orders. Verified with a dry-run of the same batch validator before applying: no point overlap, no new edge crossing, all 360-degree winding orders unchanged.
transcript.noteZh: 第一輪，一次整批。目標正方取 x∈[15,37]、y∈[14,36]（邊長 22）——因為環本來就有兩邊在線上：西側六站（35/86/22/39/95/53）全在 col 15、南側四站（61/30/38/8）全在 row 36，這兩邊完全不用動。四邊改用「環序弧段」分配而不是徑向角度：R=[11,24,46,47,88,83,57,55,87,64] 貼 col 37（列號沿用原本的遞增序 14..31）、B=[61,30,38,8] 原地、L=[35,86,22,39,95,53] 原地（只有 53 由 13 滑到 14，正好落在左上角）、T=[17,19,71] 貼 row 14。11 直接落在右上角，所以只需兩個轉角控制點：(37,36) 夾在 64 與 61 之間、(15,36) 夾在 8 與 35 之間。非環站全部由同一個連續形變一起搬，不留下擋路的點：環內走舊環對正方的均值座標（正方是凸的，所以映射保證單射、環內的環繞序不會翻），環外把當地邊界位移整個平移過去、再沿外向射線線性衰減到畫布邊界為零（每條射線上是單調映射，所以舊 col 31 與新 col 37 之間被壓縮的東側走廊是均勻壓縮而不是塌成一團）。先試過純徑向（保角度）warp，它把 24/46 推到上邊，樞紐 65/96/24/5 的環繞序全破；改成弧段分配後全部解決。之後只剩一個點不過：68 落在 (39,25)，正好壓在 55(37,27)–79(41,23) 這條線上，同時造成點壓線與「68 與 79 在 55 的視角同角度」；把 68 往東挪一格到 (40,25) 就同時解掉點壓線與兩個環繞序。套用前先用同一套整批驗證器做過乾跑：無撞格壓線、無新增交叉、360° 環繞序全部不變。
